title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
Accounts Payable Administrator
Location: Redditch
Salary: 26,000 per annum
Working arrangements: Hybrid working (2 days a week in the office) and flexibility

Flora Partners are recruiting for an Accounts Payable Administrator to join a friendly and supportive finance team based in Redditch.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous accounts payable or invoice processing experience who is looking to build on their existing skills or simply enjoy a better work-life balance.

The business offers a flexible working environment, with the opportunity to develop and progress for someone who wants to, although progression is certainly not an expectation.

As an Accounts Payable Administrator, you will support the day-to-day running of the purchase ledger function, ensuring invoices are processed accurately and efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and resolving discrepancies.
- Handling supplier queries and liaising with internal departments.
- Supporting supplier statement reconciliations.
- Ensuring invoices are correctly coded and authorised.
- Assisting with payment runs and maintaining accurate supplier records.
- Identifying and resolving invoice discrepancies.
- Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team.

Ideally, you will:
- Have previous accounts payable, purchase ledger or invoice processing experience.
- Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Be organised and able to manage your own workload.
- Have good communication skills and be confident handling queries.
- Be comfortable using finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Enjoy working as part of a team whilst also being able to work independently.
- Have a positive, proactive and adaptable approach.

In return, you will:
- Receive a salary of 26,000 per annum.
- Benefit from hybrid working and flexibility.
- Join a friendly and supportive finance team.
- Enjoy a good work-life balance.
- Have the opportunity to develop your skills and progress, should you wish to.

Interested?

Please apply with your CV for further information.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper Droitwich

Salary: 28,000 to 40,000 (dependent on experience)
Ref: BCR/JC/32588
Location: Droitwich

Bell Cornwall Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Bookkeeper to join a growing organisation based in Droitwich. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a small, friendly team and develop your finance skills within a varied and fast-paced environment.

The opportunity

Are you a numerate, organised individual with an eye for detail and an interest in finance? This Bookkeeper role offers the chance to build on your existing experience, develop your knowledge of Xero and gain exposure to a broad range of financial activities. Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the smooth running of the finance function.

What you'll be doing

As the Bookkeeper, you will:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records using Xero accounting software.
- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
- Complete general ledger reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
- Record journal entries in line with double-entry bookkeeping principles.
- Assist with preparing financial reports, including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements.
- Analyse financial data to identify inconsistencies or irregularities.
- Maintain organised records of transactions and expenses to support tax preparation.
- Use spreadsheets for financial analysis and reporting.
- Assist with month-end procedures and audit preparation as required.

About you
- Previous experience in bookkeeping or a similar finance or accounting role.
- An understanding of accounting software, ideally Xero or a similar system.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence using spreadsheets.
- An understanding of debits and credits, double-entry bookkeeping and account reconciliations.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
- Strong analytical and communication skills.
- A proactive attitude, with a willingness to learn and develop within a supportive team.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Finance Assistant
Location: Worcester Salary: £27,000
Working pattern: Hybrid, three days in the office and two days from home
Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm
Job type: Permanent, full-time
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant looking for a broader role with exposure to month-end accounting?
An established and successful organisation based in the Worcester area is looking to recruit a Finance Assistant into its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with transactional finance experience who would like to develop their knowledge of balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, prepayments and international accounting.
The position offers a varied workload covering purchase ledger, bank reconciliations, expenses, and month-end support. You will work closely with an experienced finance team and have the opportunity to develop your accounting knowledge while taking ownership of several important processes.
Your new role
- Processing purchase invoices and maintaining accurate ledger records
- Reviewing the purchase ledger and resolving supplier queries
- Preparing supplier payment runs and ensuring payments are made in line with agreed terms
- Completing daily bank reconciliations
- Supporting the month-end process
- Assisting with balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments
- Raising intercompany invoices and completing intercompany reconciliations
- Preparing information to support VAT returns
- Producing expenditure analysis and spend-versus-budget reports
- Supporting customer invoice queries and processing approved credit notes

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Assistant Accountant or similar position
- Practical experience across purchase ledger, cash book or nominal ledger accounting
- Experience completing bank reconciliations
- An understanding of accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations
- Good Excel skills, including the ability to create and manipulate spreadsheets
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload
- A proactive, flexible and team-focused approach

An AAT qualification or current AAT studies would be advantageous but are not essential. Additional language skills would also be useful, although they are not required.
What you'll get in return
- Salary of £27,000
- Hybrid working, with three days in the office and two days from home
- A 35-hour working week
- Broad exposure across transactional finance and month-end accounting
- Support from an established finance team
- The opportunity to develop towards a more senior accounting position

This role would be particularly suitable for an experienced transactional finance professional who is ready to broaden their responsibilities and gain more meaningful month-end exposure.
What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant / Accounts Assistant

Location: Malvern, Worcestershire
Salary: 26,000 - 27,000 per annum
Hours: 25-35 hours per week
Job Type: Permanent Full-time or Part-time
Benefits: On-site gym

The Opportunity

Vibe Recruit is working on behalf of an established business in Malvern to recruit a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Assistant / Accounts Assistant to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in accounts administration, credit control or finance who is looking to develop their skills within a supportive working environment.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the business, including invoicing, payment processing, account reconciliations and tenant account management.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with accounts payable and receivable, including processing invoices, payments and expenses.
- Maintain accurate financial records and tenant accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Support credit control and rent collection activities, contacting tenants regarding outstanding payments via telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Complete bank reconciliations and ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded.
- Assist with the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain and update financial databases using Xero and Microsoft Excel.
- Monitor outstanding balances and produce regular reports on arrears, payment status and collection progress.
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the finance and property management teams.
- Ensure financial processes are carried out in accordance with company procedures.
- Assist with audits and other ad hoc finance-related projects.

About You

The ideal candidate will be organised, proactive and confident working with financial information, with the ability to manage competing priorities and communicate professionally with customers and colleagues.

We are looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in an accounts, finance administration, credit control or similar role.
- Experience using accounting software such as Xero, Sage or QuickBooks.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Confident communication skills, particularly when dealing with payment queries and outstanding balances.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team.
- A professional, approachable manner and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Experience in property management, tenant accounts or Workday software would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 27,000 per annum.
- Full-time or part-time opportunity, working 25-35 hours per week.
- On-site gym.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
- Varied responsibilities across finance and property management.
- The opportunity to join an established business.

If you are an experienced Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity in Malvern, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your updated CV to find out more about this opportunity.

Vibe Recruit is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Payroll Administrator
company: Four Squared Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Administrator
Redditch £30,000 Full Time, Permanent
Are you highly organised, confident working with Excel, and experienced in managing administrative queries and timesheet data?
An established employer is seeking a Payroll Administrator to support the smooth running of the payroll process. Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you'll play a key role in maintaining accurate records, processing timesheet information, resolving payroll-related queries, and ensuring data is accurate and up to date.
This role would suit someone who enjoys working with spreadsheets and data, has excellent attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and organisation are essential.
The Role
As Payroll Administrator, you'll provide vital support to the Payroll function, ensuring payroll information is collected, checked, and processed accurately. You will be responsible for managing employee queries, maintaining records, and producing accurate data for payroll processing.
Key Responsibilities
- Managing payroll and administrative queries from employees and managers in a professional and timely manner
- Collecting, reviewing, and validating timesheets, overtime submissions, absence records, and payroll amendments
- Maintaining and updating payroll data using Excel and SAGE
- Investigating and resolving discrepancies, ensuring data accuracy at all times
- Producing reports, spreadsheets, and payroll information to support payroll processing
- Processing new starter, leaver, and employee change documentation
- Maintaining accurate employee records and electronic filing systems
- Liaising with managers across multiple sites to obtain outstanding information and timesheet submissions
- Preparing letters, forms, and supporting documentation as required
- Handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion
- Providing general administrative support to the Payroll and wider People function

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Strong Excel skills, including experience working with spreadsheets, data validation, and reconciliations
- Previous experience in payroll administration, timesheet processing, workforce administration, or data administration
- Experience managing a high volume of queries via email and telephone
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to administration
- Confidence working with numerical data and identifying discrepancies
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and deadlines
- Good communication skills and the ability to build relationships across the business
- A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information
- A positive, proactive, and team-oriented attitude

Desirable Experience
- Experience working with large datasets and maintaining accurate records
- Knowledge of payroll processes and employee administration
- Experience within a multi-site business environment

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Company pension scheme
- Employee benefits programme
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Flexible working pattern
- Casual dress
- Free onsite parking

Apply Today
If you're a highly organised and people-focused administrator looking for a varied role within a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.
This is a permanent, full time position based in Redditch.
For more information on this position, please contact Harriet Ali at Four Squared Recruitment.
If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We thank you for your interest and encourage you to apply for future opportunities.

title: Payroll Assistant
company: MultiStaff Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Payroll Associate, you will support the smooth and compliant delivery of payroll services for a wide range of clients. Working closely with the Payroll Manager and wider team, you will process payrolls accurately, help with onboarding new clients, respond to client queries, and ensure deadlines are consistently met. This role is ideal for someone who is detail oriented, organised, and keen to develop within a growing payroll function.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing
- Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls accurately within agreed deadlines.
- Prepare and submit RTI submissions, EPS, and pension contributions.
- Handle statutory payments (SSP, SMP, SPP), holiday pay, adjustments, and payroll corrections.
- Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, starters, leavers, and amendments.

Client Support & Communication
- Respond to client queries promptly and professionally.
- Liaise with Client Managers where further clarification or fee discussions are required.
- Maintain high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, and client care.

Team Support & Workflow
- Assist with organising workload and supporting team members during peak times.
- Provide holiday/emergency cover where needed.
- Support the allocation of new payrolls and follow internal processes consistently.

Onboarding & Compliance
- Support onboarding of new payroll clients by gathering required information and setting up systems.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC, pension providers, and internal governance.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation, software updates, and internal procedures.

Operational Administration
- Keep target sheets, internal trackers and payroll checklists updated (where required).

The salary is based on full time so will be pro rota.

Flexible working hours but ideally Monday - Friday around 5 hours per day.
